entries.name: Volatility-targeted Bitcoin
entries.registered: rule and pass bar written down and pushed before the run (2026-11-11 01:20 UTC)
entries.idea: Hold Bitcoin, but hold less of it when it has recently been jumping around, aiming for a smoother ride.
entries.period: Last 30% of Bitcoin's history (never used to design the rule)

results.k: Sharpe (return per unit of risk), rule vs holding

conditions.rule: Worst drop at least 10 points shallower

entries.reading: Reacting to volatility added nothing over just holding a bit less Bitcoin.
entries.not_verified: Cash earned nothing in the test. Fees were modelled; real trading would differ.

entries.name: Crypto momentum (top 5 of 28 coins)
entries.idea: Each week, hold the five coins that rose most over the last 90 days.
entries.period: Last 30% of the history of 28 coins

conditions.rule: Sharpe at least 0.15 above holding every coin

entries.reading: It beat random picking and the whole list, but took more risk than Bitcoin for it.
entries.not_verified: The coin list is coins that exist today, so dead coins are missing and the result is flattered by an unknown amount.

entries.name: Momentum with a Bitcoin trend filter
entries.idea: The same momentum rule, but only invested while Bitcoin is above its 200-day average; otherwise cash.
entries.period: Last 30% of the history of 28 coins

conditions.rule: Sharpe at least 0.15 above the gated list
Return above zero, at least 30 trades

entries.reading: A near miss: better on most counts, but the worst drop was still deeper than Bitcoin's, which was the reason for the filter. Closed, not retuned.
entries.not_verified: Same survivorship flattery as above. This was the second look at one idea, so a pass would have counted for less.

entries.name: Bitcoin funding carry (market-neutral)
entries.registered: commit 539ca0e, simulator committed before the run (4833b9f)
entries.idea: Hold Bitcoin and short the matching futures contract to collect its funding payments, switching on only when payments beat Treasury bills.

results.k: Always holding the carry, per year

conditions.rule: Beats bills by at least 1 point a year
At least as good as always holding the carry

entries.reading: Funding paid well in 2024 but less than bills this past year, and the 11 switches cost more in fees than they earned.
entries.not_verified: Exchange, price-mismatch and liquidation risk are not modelled. One market cycle of data.
